newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aoki says in last stage of NY hotel sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Aoki says in last stage of NY hotel sale talks.

text.p: Japanese construction company Aoki Corp said on Thursday that it was in the final stage of negotiations to sell the Algonquin Hotel in New York to Atlanta's Camberley Hotel.
A spokesman for Aoki declined to provide details of the negotiations.
The Aoki spokesman said that a sale would be part of efforts to reduce the firm's assets and debts.
Aoki bought the Algonquin Hotel in 1987 for about $30 million, he said.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its evening edition on Thursday that Aoki and Camberley were likely to reach agreement by the end of this month.
